anchors.behavior: selects by moduleId and prefers houseDefinition.cityId === currentCityId before falling back to any matching module house
council-arrival reminder derives both targetHouseId and defaultSpeakerCharacterId from the selected HouseDefinition
refusal flows reuse the same selected HouseDefinition for targetHouseName and speakerCharacterId

frozenInference.currentSelectorContract: The selector assumes city-scoped HouseDefinition records still exist for keep-house and temple-house review owners.
frozenInference.canonicalHostRisk: Once repeated-name hosts converge onto one shared canonical house record, city-scoped preference by houseDefinition.cityId becomes advisory only. The fallback branch can still return the first canonical house record even when currentCityId belongs to another city.
frozenInference.speakerRisk: Because the selected HouseDefinition also owns defaultCharacterId, council reminder/refusal flows would inherit one city's host speaker as the default across every city sharing the canonical house unless a city-scoped projection seam exists.

exampleScenario.selectorOutcome: fallback returns house.template.keep even though cityId does not match city.other
resultingDrift: targetHouseId remains usable as a canonical routing token
speakerCharacterId still drifts to npc.start.guard instead of a city.other host unless another seam supplies city-scoped speaker truth

nonGoals: does not widen into full source rewrite
does not decide final speaker-authoring policy for all module houses
does not reopen settlement or nextEventId queues

recommendedNextSlice.goal: freeze a city-scoped council-priority projection seam that can preserve canonical targetHouseId while sourcing city-local speaker/name truth before broad host-id source rewrite lands
